applicability: The Jump to selected review control in the existing review workspace.
conditions: The existing center is the focus and scroll target.
The jump focuses without the browser default scroll and explicitly aligns the target start.
exclusions: The jump changes no layout, full-file disclosure, source selection or persisted knowledge.
statement: Jump to selected review preserves keyboard focus while explicitly aligning the existing center scroll target at its start.
